data.description:
## Story DD Coverage
- dd-2 (apply-half): merges additive content into kept issue
- dd-3: Post-pass bridge-fsck duplicate count drops to zero or to a reviewer-acknowledged residual

Add apply subcommand to plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/duplicates_band.py. Accepts --pass <N>. First invokes gate logic (task-3) — exits non-zero without mutations if gate fails. Reads manifest from task-2. For each duplicate set: (a) merge labels (union, no deletions), append comments referencing closee keys, union watchers into keeper via AcliClient; (b) close each newer duplicate with resolution comment referencing keeper key; (c) record per-issue success/failure to bridge_state/bootstrap/duplicates-<pass>.apply.log.json. After all sets: run enumerate_duplicate_anomalies() post-pass, assert count==0 OR matches residual-ack.json. Partial-failure: continue on per-set failure, log it, final exit non-zero if unacknowledged failures.

## TDD Test Spec
Given valid manifest (keeper=PROJ-100, closee=PROJ-200), valid human-signed attested.json, mocked AcliClient, enumerate returns empty post-pass; When apply --pass 1 invoked; Then AcliClient recorded: label union on PROJ-100, comment append referencing PROJ-200, PROJ-200 closed with keeper reference; audit log records both as success; exit 0. Given no attested.json; Then exits non-zero, zero AcliClient calls.

## testing_mode: RED
data.title: Add apply subcommand to duplicates_band.py: merges+closes duplicates then runs post-pass fsck
